verdict.rationale: Exa offers event-driven building blocks: Websets webhooks deliver real-time HTTP callbacks when items are added or enriched [exa-docs-21], and scheduled searches surface new web events [exa-docs-10]. Websets criteria and enrichment fields also act as declarative rules applied to each result [exa-docs-28]. However, there is no evidence of a rule engine where users define conditions that trigger arbitrary actions; any downstream action has to be built by the user on top of the callbacks. Missing for 10: user-defined condition→action rule configuration, built-in action targets beyond HTTP callbacks, detailed documentation of monitor/webhook configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
